thread:
emma: FYI support ticket from Acme shows repeated 504/502s during tenant onboarding bursts this morning. customer says it happens ~30s after first request.
raj: seeing the same in prod metrics — spike at 08:12 UTC, queue length + KEDA scaler triggered but pods stayed NotReady.
jordan: logs look like model server init stalled on GPU warmup, readiness probe failing. sample logs: ```2026-03-15T08:12:34Z model-init: loading weights...
2026-03-15T08:12:58Z readiness: probe timeout after 25s
2026-03-15T08:13:03Z kubelet: killing pod due to readiness failure```
lisa-support: customer got a 504 and then a 502 on retry, they pasted request-id: r-0ab12c. they are on hosted inference, region eu-west-1. escalated to SE.
emma: interesting — note they also mentioned auth hiccups earlier in the burst window. could be token rotation + slow scale causing gateway to return 5xx while backend is still cold.
raj: checked KEDA ScaledObject: external metric is queueLength, cooldown: 30s, pollingInterval: 5s. HPA minReplicas=0. prewarm annotation is set to "warmup=true" but I see prewarm hook isn't being picked up. might be a reconcile ordering issue between KEDA and prewarm controller.
jordan: reproduction steps I ran locally against staging to mimic: ```# enqueue 100 requests in 10s to tenant queue
for i in {1..100}; do curl -s -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/v1/infer -d '{"prompt":"x"}' & done``` results: majority 504s for first 20s, then steady once enough pods were Ready.
infra-bot: Alert: incident-created INC-20260315-42 | symptom=gateway-504-spike | customer=acme | region=eu-west-1
lisa-support: customer also attached BLOB of auth logs showing intermittent 401s exactly when billing service returned "rate-limit-exceeded" for token mint. they retried and then saw 502s.
emma: hypothesis: two contributing factors — (1) KEDA/HPA minReplicas=0 + prewarm not firing -> pods cold and readiness delays; (2) auth token mint rate-limited by billing service leading to transient 401s that the gateway interprets as backend failures and surfaces 5xx. combination makes retries cascade.
raj: immediate mitigation proposals: 1) bump HPA minReplicas to 1 for onboarding tenant namespace, 2) temporarily disable KEDA scaler for that namespace (keda.autoscaling.redwood/disabled=true), 3) increase readiness probe timeout on model server to 60s for suspect model variants.
jordan: added a quick patch config in staging and reran the burst, got 95% success within first 15s once minReplicas=1.
lisa-support: shared workaround with customer — asked them to retry with exponential backoff for 60s window while we patch infra. they accepted.
emma: longer term actions: - fix prewarm controller reconcile ordering so KEDA scale events wait for prewarm lifecycle; - add circuit-breaker in gateway for auth-mint failures so we return 429 instead of propagating as 502; - add telemetry to measure time-to-ready for pods after scale event.
ops-bot: Runbook note appended to INC-20260315-42: "If tenant onboarding 5xx spike, set HPA.minReplicas=1 and tag for investigation."
raj: creating a small canary rollout to prod with minReplicas=1 for onboarding profiles, will monitor 1h then revert if no regressions.
jordan: logging/observability TODOs: capture pod creation -> ready latency histogram per model, and correlate with auth-token-mint latencies. I can add dashboards.
lisa-support: closing loop with customer — scheduled a 1:1 to confirm mitigation and follow-up timeline. they asked for postmortem.
emma: thanks team. saving the repro steps & sample logs into the incident doc. if anyone sees different error patterns (403s vs 401s) ping here. :thumbsup:
